name: Ice Titan
summary: Optional endgame encounter: Diamond Dust.
instructions: Guard the small ice lances back at the Titan until he kneels, then attack his head with aerial combos. Keep moving between volleys. Do not use Aero: it changes the lances into larger projectiles that cannot be reflected. This is a solo encounter.
prerequisites: Clear the Phil, Pegasus, Hercules and Hades Cups.

name: Sephiroth
summary: Optional endgame encounter: One-Winged Angel; Ansem’s Report 12.
instructions: Equip defensive abilities such as Second Chance and Leaf Bracer if learned, set Cure to a shortcut, and carry Elixirs or healing items. Use short punishes after his attacks. Interrupt Heartless Angel before the halo transfers; if it lands, HP becomes 1 and MP becomes 0, so recover immediately with an item. Keep moving during the meteor sequence. Final Mix Sonic Blade does not give invulnerability throughout its follow-up thrusts.
prerequisites: Unlock the first three cups and seal Hollow Bastion’s Keyhole.

name: Kurt Zisa
summary: Optional endgame encounter: Zantetsuken; Ansem’s Report 11.
instructions: Summon before the opening magic seal if using a summon. Break the orbs in his hands with physical attacks, then strike the exposed head. When he raises his barrier, use offensive magic to break it; physical hits on the barrier can supply MP. Dodge the spinning charges rather than chasing them.
prerequisites: After rescuing Kairi in Hollow Bastion, speak to the Carpet in Aladdin’s House.

name: Phantom
summary: Optional endgame encounter: Stop upgrade.
instructions: Carry MP recovery and set Stop to a shortcut. Lock onto the clock hands and cast Stop to delay Doom; renew it regularly. Damage the exposed heart according to its color: white physical, red Fire, blue Blizzard, yellow Thunder. Back away when the heart is absent and preserve MP for the clock.
prerequisites: After rescuing Kairi, put Peter Pan in the party and speak to Tinker Bell in the ship’s Cabin.

name: Unknown
summary: Optional endgame encounter: EXP Necklace; Ansem’s Report 13.
instructions: Prepare healing and MP restoration, and summon Tinker Bell early if desired. Track his teleport cloud and use Gravity to create an opening, then use a brief combo before backing off. If the command menu becomes Shock/Release, select Release to break the curse. Avoid selecting Shock. Save recovery items for the faster closing phase.

name: Completion run planning
summary: Use a thorough run for collection, Journal records and optional encounters.
instructions: Choose Proud if you also want the highest-difficulty clear goal: modern 1.5 + 2.5 difficulty achievements allow higher difficulty to satisfy lower tiers. Explore each world, revisit after movement and Trinity upgrades, then finish synthesis, cups, optional bosses and Gummi missions. A separate fast restricted run can reduce competing goals, but two runs are a recommendation, not a requirement.

name: Restricted run planning
summary: Plan the three conditions separately, with a Beginner run as the straightforward combined route.
instructions: For a combined run, choose Beginner and leave every party member’s weapon and accessories as received, including Sora, Donald and Goofy. Keep Beginner’s pre-equipped accessories in place. Abilities, magic, recovery-item slots and permanent stat-boost items remain usable; improve those instead of replacing equipment. Story-driven weapon changes occur automatically, so continue the story without making manual swaps to compensate. Save regularly in separate slots. For Undefeated, if defeated, return to the title screen and load a clean save instead of selecting Continue. For Speedster, defeat World of Chaos before the in-game timer reaches 15 hours. Plan the route in advance, skip optional cleanup and leave ample time for the final sequence. Let the credits finish and reach the results screen: Steam players report Unchanging Armor and Undefeated unlocking there, while Speedster unlocks at the boss defeat. Check the Steam award before reusing the run save for unrestricted play.

name: Coliseum strategy — Yuffie
summary: Practical encounter guidance for Yuffie.
instructions: Guard her shuriken to create an opening. Keep pressure on her so she has fewer chances to heal.

name: Coliseum strategy — Leon & Yuffie
summary: Practical encounter guidance for Leon & Yuffie.
instructions: Focus on Yuffie first to remove her healing. Reflect her shuriken with Guard; once she falls, guard or dodge Leon and attack after his heavy swings.

name: Coliseum strategy — Cloud
summary: Practical encounter guidance for Cloud.
instructions: Evade his lunging attacks and punish the pause afterward. Keep enough MP for Cure.

name: Coliseum strategy — Hercules
summary: Practical encounter guidance for Hercules.
instructions: Lock on, lift a barrel, and throw it at Hercules to remove his glowing invulnerability. Attack in the resulting opening, then retreat before his counterattack.

name: Coliseum strategy — Behemoth
summary: Practical encounter guidance for Behemoth.
instructions: Reach its back and attack the horn. Move away from the charged attack, then return to the horn.

name: Coliseum strategy — Cerberus
summary: Practical encounter guidance for Cerberus.
instructions: Keep moving around the dark ground eruptions. Attack a head after the biting sequence, and use ranged attacks only when you have spare MP.

name: Coliseum strategy — Cloud & Leon
summary: Practical encounter guidance for Cloud & Leon.
instructions: Focus damage on one opponent. Cloud has less HP; watch Leon while attacking Cloud and keep a safe reserve for healing.

name: Coliseum strategy — Hades
summary: Practical encounter guidance for Hades.
instructions: Evade when he turns red and uses fire. Follow the rotation of his large flame attack to stay between the jets; resume damage after he cools down.

name: Coliseum strategy — Rock Titan
summary: Practical encounter guidance for Rock Titan.
instructions: Attack a foot until the Titan falls, then climb to a head and use short aerial combos. Jump over shockwaves.

name: Muddy Path — find all six friends
summary: A complete route through Rabbit, Roo, Tigger, Owl and Piglet after finding Eeyore.
instructions: 1. Speak to Pooh in the mud, then examine the central bushes to find Eeyore. 2. Lock onto Pooh and bring him to the holes beside the well. Face Rabbit when he emerges and select Talk. 3. Strike the exposed tree root in the muddy lower area to bring down Roo, then speak to him. 4. Ride the air rising from the well to the upper ledge. Get onto the hollow log and talk to Tigger. 5. Return to the upper ledge, cross the log and continue uphill. Wait for Owl to land in the corner, then speak to him. 6. Return to Pooh and lock on to guide him to the first blue flowers; they lift him uphill. Lead him to the hollow log, jump over it yourself, then lock on again from the far side so he walks through. Guide him to the next blue flowers and the tree hole. Pooh persuades Piglet to come down. Drop to the lower level and talk to Piglet to finish. For Cheer, finish within five minutes.
prerequisites: Return all five Torn Pages and finish the earlier book episodes.

name: Phil’s barrel training — routes and repeat practice
summary: Efficient routes for the 20-barrel and 25-barrel tests; keep repeat practice separate from the first-clear reward.
instructions: Easy: hit the middle of the first three barrels, a bottom barrel in the four-barrel stack, the bottom center of the six-barrel stack, then a bottom barrel in the next four. Lift and throw one of the last barrels into another. Advanced: clear the four to your left; turn and knock the single barrel toward the two-barrel stack. Throw a survivor toward the raised row of three, then clear that row. On the next level, knock the single toward the four-barrel group and clear the leftovers, then the six-barrel group. Throw the highest loose barrel at the isolated barrel on the elevated platform. Finish the remaining pair at the back with a throw. For practice, improve your own finish time while using the same 30-second and 60-second limits. Thunder is the reward for passing the initial pair of tests.
uncertainty: The reviewed KH1 sources do not document a separate saved replay-record field, replay reward, or higher target beyond the two initial tests. Practice times are personal goals; no KH2 orb-score requirement is imported.
